# The Quiet Cost of X
The first time a team adopts X, nothing breaks. That's the trap [eng.example/x-postmortem].

## The hook
For a quarter, velocity climbs and everyone celebrates. Then the second system lands, and the seams that X papered over start to tear [eng.example/x-postmortem].

## The payoff
X is not a mistake — it is a loan. Teams that name the interest early keep the speed; teams that don't pay it back with interest. Decide which one you are before the second system, not after.
